text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 轻科幻 · 轨道观景温室 · 纯环境.
Environment: An empty near-future orbital observatory greenhouse lounge, pearl-white curved structural ribs, matte cream wall panels, pale natural wood benches, a few contained green planters, large window framing a softly blue planet and delicate stars. Gentle white architectural lighting, no neon cyberpunk, no control screens with people, no clutter. Accessible human-scale walkway, poetic hopeful science fiction. Premium dimensional 3D romance game environment, airy dreamlike quality, physically tactile materials, pearl white stone, restrained fine silver and warm wood, soft lavender/seafoam accents, broad soft light, luminous exposure preserving texture, low contrast shadows, very subtle halation. Elegant, intimate and spatially plausible, not a cluttered game splash art, not dark or greasy. Strictly environment only: absolutely no people, bodies, faces, hands, silhouettes, distant pedestrians, reflections of people, animals, birds, fish, pets, mannequins, humanoid statues, character artwork or human figures on screens. No watermark, branding or captions. Keep clear usable space for later character compositing. Natural proportions, believable architecture, no fisheye, no excessive HDR, no greasy shine, no orange color cast.
Visual medium: otome 2d5d 3d; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Use case: spatial production design. Create 建筑图 for 轻科幻 · 轨道观景温室 · 纯环境. Image 1 is the geometric source of truth. Image 2 is original material and style reference. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. Keep the plan footprint, doors, windows, fixed landmarks and circulation exactly consistent. Concept reconstruction, not measured construction. Match original color palette and rendering style, detailed legible clean image, landscape. NO people, animals, silhouettes or figures on posters. No fake measurements, no watermarks.
